_note: Every crest here was downloaded from Wikimedia Commons and is tagged public domain there, because a logo made only of type and simple shapes falls below the threshold of originality and carries no copyright. Nothing here came from a site reposting logos under its own fair-use claim. The files are the black-on-transparent variants recoloured white for a dark background; shape and proportions are unchanged. The trademark always remains the org's: these appear only to identify the team whose players are listed, and imply no endorsement. Orgs whose mark is original artwork keep a generated monogram instead.
